privacy.contact_text: This website has no forms. If you choose to contact us by WhatsApp, email or telephone, the firm receives the information you share in order to answer your enquiry. These channels use third-party services with their own privacy terms. Please agree on a suitable channel with the firm before sending sensitive documents.

privacy.description: How contact details, visit measurement and external services are used on the Portillo Kus & Asociados website.
privacy.measurement_text: If Umami is enabled, it measures visits and clicks on website buttons without analytics cookies. This helps the firm understand which pages and contact options are used. Website events do not include enquiry messages or documents. This does not mean that connectivity or hosting providers cannot process technical information, such as IP addresses, to deliver their services.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.rights_text: Argentine Law 25,326 provides rights of access, correction, updating and, where applicable, deletion of your personal data. Access is free every six months, unless a legitimate interest supports an earlier request. The law allows ten calendar days to answer an access request and five working days for correction, updating or deletion.
privacy.resources_text: Delivering this page requires exchanging technical information with the hosting provider. Photos and fonts are served from this site; fonts are not downloaded from Google Fonts. Optional connections to Umami Cloud or Google Maps are described above. The scope and retention of technical information depend on the services used. You can contact the firm about the current configuration.
